title: S1 · The Road In
note: The campaign's own overture, not a shuffle. Six separate arrivals get one piece of music, not six -- the montage already carries the variety; the score's job here is continuity across the cuts, the way a real cold-open plays one theme under every quick scene. No ambience: a montage crosses too many different places for one bed to be honest about any of them, and the track is meant to read as score, not room tone.
